```python
"""Small text helpers."""
import re


def truncate(text, width):
    """Cut text to `width` characters, ending with '...' when it was shortened."""
    if len(text) <= width:
        return text
    return text[: max(width - 3, 0)] + "..."


def word_count(text):
    """Count the words in a piece of text."""
    return len(text.split())


def slugify(text):
    """Convert text to a URL-friendly slug.
    
    Lowercases everything, replaces spaces with dashes, and removes punctuation.
    """
    # Convert to lowercase
    text = text.lower()
    # Replace spaces with dashes
    text = text.replace(" ", "-")
    # Remove all punctuation characters (keeping alphanumeric and dashes)
    text = re.sub(r"[^a-z0-9-]", "", text)
    return text
```

```python
    assert slugify("Hello World") == "hello-world"

    assert slugify("Hello, World!") == "hello-world"
```
